title: tastyeffectco/sandboxd
claim: tastyeffectco/sandboxd — Open-source, self-hosted AI app builder — an agent builds real apps in isolated sandboxes on your own server, each live
why_good: An open, self-hosted 'agent builds real apps in isolated sandboxes' platform — the safe execution layer that makes agent-built software actually runnable.
value: Sell hosted sandboxes + a team tier to devs who want agent-built apps without wiring their own isolation/infra.
risk: Vercel/Replit/E2B are racing on agent sandboxes; self-host appeals to some, but the hosted incumbents move fast.
pick_reason: The project offers a clear product for enterprises to build and test AI applications securely, which can be monetized.

zh.claim: tastyeffectco/sandboxd —— 开源、可自托管的 AI 应用构建器:agent 在你自己机器的隔离沙箱里真正构建应用。
zh.why_good: 一个开源、可自托管的 agent 在隔离沙箱里造真实应用 平台——让 agent 造的软件真能跑起来的安全执行层。
zh.value: 给想要 agent 造 app、又不想自己搭隔离/基础设施的开发者卖托管沙箱 + 团队版。
zh.risk: Vercel/Replit/E2B 都在抢 agent 沙箱;自托管对部分人有吸引力,但托管巨头跑得快。
